name: content_distribution
objective: Build campaign-aligned commercial content clusters from approved public evidence while preserving Tayoca's private-source and two-stage human publication controls.

in_place_patches.name: parent_child_campaign_attribution
in_place_patches.effect: Preserve pgc1_* as parent_campaign_id/utm_campaign while retaining a unique child editorial campaign_id. Legacy opportunities keep their prior behaviour.

in_place_patches.name: fragment_safe_utm_builder
in_place_patches.effect: Insert UTM parameters before #assessment-form so browser query parameters reach the certified assessment intake.

in_place_patches.name: growth_cycle_opportunity_preference
in_place_patches.effect: Prefer review-required public-safe opportunities associated with pgc1_* campaigns; fall back to the legacy eligible public pool when no Growth Cycle opportunity exists.

in_place_patches.name: openrouter_model_reliability
in_place_patches.effect: Replace the unreliable openrouter/free dependency with google/gemini-2.5-flash-lite using structured JSON, low temperature, bounded token output, retries, and timeout controls.

in_place_patches.name: evidence_and_cta_guardrails
in_place_patches.effect: Strengthen the existing generator and campaign-pack validator so unsupported qualitative claims, source-acquisition language, and assessment CTA drift fail closed.

in_place_patches.name: deterministic_public_copy_normalization
in_place_patches.effect: Reconstruct public-facing title, hook, body, and CTA only from the approved source, fact, story angle, and assessment destination while retaining model-selected channel formats and asset concepts.
